_note: operations-sync-status-and-progress: the organisation sync's schedule, its last run and a running sync, for Nextcloud admins and functional administrators. The menu entry carries permission sync.view, which DashboardController provides only to those users (D5); src/menu-layout.json relocates it under Organisations (ADR-097). The page is custom because it polls GET /api/sync/status while a run is going, which no built-in page type does.

pages.title: Synchronisation
pages._note: Custom, not a built-in type: the page asks GET /api/sync/status again every three seconds while a run is going and stops when it ends, which no built-in page type does. The endpoint refuses anyone but Nextcloud admins and functional administrators with 403; the menu entry hides itself for them through permission sync.view.
